svg.text: c5: WAL per event by statement
Shows: WAL bytes per event split by statement (pg_stat_statements, mean of the repetitions): inbound INSERT, routing / switch (B), claim (A), MERGE into orders, cleanup (UPDATE / DELETE /
TRUNCATE) and other = total WAL − those statements (vacuum, checkpoints, bookkeeping).
Purpose: Where each design's write amplification comes from (docs/comparison.md).
